title: Resource
key_points: Resource is the base class for all Godot-specific resource types.
Resources are reference-counted and freed when no longer in use.
The engine keeps a global cache of all loaded resources, referenced by paths.
In C#, resources will not be freed instantly after they are no longer in use.
Resources can be loaded from disk using GDScript's @GDScript.load() or @GDScript.preload().
asserts: Resource serves primarily as data containers for serializable objects.
scope: Describes the Resource class in Godot engine, its properties and methods.
